headline: Sheinbaum offers support to coffee growers in Chiapas and asks Sader to intervene in negotiations with Nestlé
summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum offered federal government support to Chiapas coffee producers protesting low prices per kilogram. She asked the Agriculture Ministry to intervene in negotiations with Nestlé for a fair payment.
why: Nestlé is one of the world's largest coffee buyers, so its purchase prices affect farm incomes and supply. Coffee price disputes can influence commodity markets and food company costs.

impacts.name: Nestlé
impacts.why: Nestlé is in price negotiations with Chiapas coffee growers, affecting its raw material purchase costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Sheinbaum ofrece apoyo a cafeticultores de Chiapas y pide a Sader intervenir en negociación con Nestlé
